text:
Celtic duo Duran and Nygren attract interest - gossip
- Published
Premier League club keep an eye on Celtic summer signing as Serie A sides monitor the champion's Swedish midfielder...
Leeds United have sent scouts to watch Celtic striker Camilo Duran this season. (The National, external)
Celtic midfielder Benjamin Nygren is on the radar of Atalanta and Bologna. (Rekatochklart via Daily Record, external)
Scott McTominay's Napoli future has been plunged into fresh doubt amid claims the 29-year-old Scotland midfielder's camp are seeking a staggering £10m-a-year deal to extend his stay in Italy. (Corriere del Mezzogiorno via The Herald, external)
Hacken sporting director Erik Friberg has described 19-year-old Celtic-linked midfielder Abdoulaye Doumbia as "incredible". (Glasgow Times, external)
Stuttgart are contemplating a move for Arne Engels only three months after the 23-year-old midfielder joined West Ham United from Celtic. (Bild via The National, external)
Wolverhampton Wanderers are among several Championship clubs interested in signing former Celtic winger Liel Abada as a free agent in January when his Charlotte contract expires. (Sky Sports, external)
Connor Barron's frustrating Middlesbrough loan spell has suffered another setback with the Rangers midfielder currently sidelined by injury. (The National, external)
- Tuesday's English & European transfer rumours 
  - Published10 hours ago
- Monday's Scottish Gossip 
  - Published1 day ago
Dunfermline Athletic are bracing themselves for Aberdeen to recall Dylan Lobban's from his loan because of the 21-year-old right-back's good form. (The Courier, external)
Steven Pressley insists he had no thoughts of quitting as Dundee head coach despite Saturday's 8-0 mauling at home to Heart of Midlothian. (The Scotsman, external)
The Scottish Football Association has been advised by the Scottish Professional Football League's competitions working group to delay the vote on its radical young player reforms until the end of the season. (Daily Record, external)
Callum McGregor remains the driving force for Celtic and criticism of the captain is completely unwarranted, says the club's former midfielder Dylan McGeouch. (Scottish Sun - subscription required, external)
Former Tynecastle goalkeeper Gilles Rousset reckons Hearts have a chance at home to Monaco on Thursday, the Frenchman saying the Conference League visitors are "not at their very best at the moment". Daily Record - subscription required, external
The financial crisis at Greenock Morton has taken another alarming turn after the club's main sponsor, Dalrada Technology Ltd, was placed into liquidation. (The Herald, external)
Scotland goalkeeping coach Chris Woods is waiting to get approval from head coach Sebastien Pocognoli over a new contract days before the 67-year-old's agreement expires. (Football Insider, external)
Steven Gerrard has revealed he brought Fulham defender Calvin Bassey to Rangers "on a steal" during his time as manager at Ibrox. (The Overlap, external)

דיווחים שונים מעידים על עניין רב שמגלות קבוצות שונות בשחקניה של סלטיק. בין היתר, לידס יונייטד שלחה סקאוטים לעקוב אחר החלוץ קמילו דוראן, בעוד שקשר הקבוצה בנג'מין ניגרן נמצא על הכוונת של אטאלנטה ובולוניה. במקביל, עתידו של סקוט מקטומינאי בנאפולי מוטל בספק בשל דרישות שכר גבוהות להארכת חוזהו.

בגזרות נוספות, וולבס מעוניינת בשחקן העבר של סלטיק ליאל אבדה כשחקן חופשי, ווולבס עשויה לצרפו בחודש ינואר. כמו כן, שטוטגרט שוקלת מהלך לגבי ארנה אנגלס, זמן קצר לאחר הצטרפותו לווסטהאם יונייטד, ודילן לובאן צפוי להיות מוחזר מחודש ההשאלה שלו עקב יכולת טובה.
